ActivateObjective.description:
Makes an objective active so that it can progress and complete.

Nothing happens when the objective is already active or already completed, or when the objective is restricted to stages that do not include the current stage. Activating clears an earlier cancellation and fires the objective's onActivated event trigger.

parameters.description: The objective to activate.
parameters.name: objectiveID

AddBuildOption.description: Adds a unit type to the build options of a builder or factory type, for its current units and for every unit of that type built later, on every team.

parameters.description: The unit type to add as a build option.
parameters.name: builtDefName

parameters.description: The builder or factory type that receives the option.
parameters.name: builderDefName

parameters.description: The slot the option takes among the builder's build options, counted from 1. Build menus that sort their options ignore it.
parameters.name: buildMenuPosition

AddCountdown.description:
Starts a countdown that runs down one second at a time and ends when it reaches zero. Countdown triggers and the other countdown actions refer to it by its countdownID.

Adding a countdown with the ID of a running one replaces it.

parameters.description: The name the countdown is known by.
parameters.name: countdownID

parameters.description: The duration in seconds, rounded to whole seconds.
parameters.name: seconds

parameters.description: Whether the countdown is meant to be shown to the player. Displayed countdowns tick together on whole seconds and hold their time through their first tick; others time their duration exactly from when they are added.
parameters.name: displayed

AddMapMarker.description:
Places a map marker at a position, visible to every player, and records it under markerName so RemoveMapMarker can erase it.

Reusing a name records the new marker and forgets the earlier one without erasing it.

parameters.description: The name the marker is known by.
parameters.name: markerName

parameters.description: Where the marker goes, with x and z in elmos; y defaults to the ground height.
parameters.name: position

parameters.description: Reserved for marker styles; it currently changes nothing about the marker.
parameters.name: markerType

parameters.description: Text shown beside the marker.
parameters.name: label

AddResources.description:
Gives a team metal and energy at once, or takes them away.

Positive amounts are added to the team's storage, and negative amounts are spent from it. Each resource is applied separately, and an omitted resource is left unchanged.

parameters.description: The team whose storage changes.
parameters.name: teamID

parameters.description: Metal to add, or to remove when negative.
parameters.name: metal

parameters.description: Energy to add, or to remove when negative.
parameters.name: energy

AddResourcesPerSecond.description:
Changes a team's ongoing income by a fixed amount of metal and energy per second for the rest of the game.

The income is delivered in two installments per second. Repeating the action adds to the rate already in effect, so a negative amount reduces or cancels an earlier rate; there is no other way to stop it. An omitted resource is left unchanged.

parameters.description: The team whose income changes.
parameters.name: teamID

parameters.description: Metal per second to add to the team's income, or to drain from it when negative.
parameters.name: metal

parameters.description: Energy per second to add to the team's income, or to drain from it when negative.
parameters.name: energy

AddTime.description: Adds seconds to the remaining time of a countdown. Does nothing when the countdown has ended or been canceled.

parameters.description: The countdown to lengthen.
parameters.name: countdownID

parameters.description: The seconds to add; the result is rounded to whole seconds.
parameters.name: seconds

AddUnitMarker.description:
Draws a marker above every unit matching the filters, stacked above any markers the unit already has. A unit holds at most one marker of each markerType.

Only units that exist when the action runs are marked, and a marker disappears with its unit. A teamID on its own matches no units.

parameters.description: Only units carrying this mission unit name.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: Only units of this type.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: Only units of this team.
parameters.name: teamID

parameters.description: A label for the marker, so RemoveUnitMarker can remove it on its own.
parameters.name: markerType

CancelCountdown.description: Removes a countdown without ending it, so no countdown-ended trigger fires for it.

parameters.description: The countdown to remove.
parameters.name: countdownID

CancelObjective.description:
Cancels an objective, deactivating it without completing or failing it.

Nothing happens when the objective is already completed or already canceled. Canceling fires the objective's onCanceled event trigger. A canceled objective can be activated again with ActivateObjective.

parameters.description: The objective to cancel.
parameters.name: objectiveID

ChangeStage.description:
Moves the mission to another stage.

Objectives listed by the current stage that are not completed are canceled, except those also listed by the new stage, which continue unchanged. Every other objective listed by the new stage is activated. Changing to the stage that is already current changes nothing.

parameters.description: The stage to make current.
parameters.name: stageID

CompleteObjective.description:
Completes an objective as a success, regardless of its own trigger.

Nothing happens when the objective is already completed or failed. Completing fires the objective's onCompleted event trigger and then, unless that trigger changed the stage, advances to the objective's nextStage once every objective of the current stage sharing that nextStage is complete. A completed objective cannot be activated again.

parameters.description: The objective to complete.
parameters.name: objectiveID

CreateFeatures.description: Spawns features, such as wrecks, rocks, and trees, from a feature loadout. Each entry names a feature definition and a position in elmos; the height is taken from the ground. An entry with a featureName creates that mission feature name for other actions and triggers to refer to.

parameters.description: The features to spawn, each with featureDefName, x, z, and optionally facing and featureName.
parameters.name: featureLoadout

Custom.description:
Runs a Lua function written in the mission script.

The function is called with no arguments, and its return value is ignored. Use it for behavior that no other action provides.

parameters.description: The function to call.
parameters.name: function

Defeat.description: Ends the game with the listed ally teams defeated; every other ally team wins.

parameters.description: The ally teams that lose.
parameters.name: allyTeamIDs

DespawnUnits.description:
Removes the units with a name from the game silently, without a death explosion or a wreck.

The units count as lost for the owning team, and UnitKilled triggers watching them fire. Nothing happens when no living unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units are removed.
parameters.name: unitName

DestroyFeatures.description: Destroys every feature currently carrying a mission feature name. Features that no longer exist are skipped.

parameters.description: The mission feature name of the features to destroy.
parameters.name: featureName

DestroyUnits.description:
Kills the units with a name, with their death explosion and wreck.

The units count as lost for the owning team, no team is credited with the kill, and UnitKilled triggers watching them fire. Nothing happens when no living unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units are destroyed.
parameters.name: unitName

DisableBuildOption.description:
Grays out a unit type in the build menus of a team so it cannot be built, either for every builder of the team or for one builder or factory type only.

The block applies to the team's current and future builders and stays until EnableBuildOption lifts it.

parameters.description: The unit type that can no longer be built.
parameters.name: builtDefName

parameters.description: Limits the block to this builder or factory type.
parameters.name: builderDefName

parameters.description: The team whose build menus are affected.
parameters.name: teamID

DisableTrigger.description:
Turns a trigger off so that it stops firing until an EnableTrigger action turns it back on.

A disabled trigger ignores its events entirely, so an event that happens while it is disabled is missed rather than held. Disabling does not reset the trigger's repeat count.

parameters.description: The trigger to disable.
parameters.name: triggerID

DisableUnitDef.description:
Stops the campaign AI of a team from building a unit type.

This only instructs the AI; the build option itself stays available, so use DisableBuildOption to gray it out as well.

parameters.description: The unit type the AI must not build.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: The AI team that receives the instruction.
parameters.name: teamID

DisableUnitsControl.description:
Tells the campaign AI of a team to leave alone the units carrying a mission unit name.

Only units that exist when the action runs are affected.

parameters.description: The mission unit name of the units to take from the AI.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: The AI team that receives the instruction.
parameters.name: teamID

DrawLines.description: Draws a line through the positions in order, visible to every player, and records it under lineName. Drawing again with the same name replaces the earlier line.

parameters.description: At least two positions, with x and z in elmos; y defaults to the ground height.
parameters.name: positions

parameters.description: The name the line is known by.
parameters.name: lineName

EnableBuildOption.description:
Lifts a block placed by DisableBuildOption. The builderDefName must match the one the block was placed with: a team-wide block is lifted only by a team-wide enable.

Blocks the game places for its own reasons, such as water or wind restrictions, are not affected.

parameters.description: The unit type to make buildable again.
parameters.name: builtDefName

parameters.description: The builder or factory type the block was placed for.
parameters.name: builderDefName

parameters.description: The team whose build menus are affected.
parameters.name: teamID

EnableTrigger.description:
Turns a trigger on so that it fires when its event next happens.

Enabling does not reset a trigger that has already fired: a non-repeating trigger that fired once stays spent, and a repeating trigger keeps its count against maxRepeats. Use this to start triggers authored with active = false.

parameters.description: The trigger to enable.
parameters.name: triggerID

EnableUnitDef.description:
Allows the campaign AI of a team to build a unit type.

This only instructs the AI; it does not change which build options exist.

parameters.description: The unit type the AI may build.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: The AI team that receives the instruction.
parameters.name: teamID

EnableUnitsControl.description:
Tells the campaign AI of a team that it may control the units carrying a mission unit name.

Only units that exist when the action runs are affected.

parameters.description: The mission unit name of the units to hand to the AI.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: The AI team that receives the instruction.
parameters.name: teamID

FailObjective.description:
Marks an objective as failed.

Nothing happens when the objective is already completed or failed. Failing fires the objective's onFailed event trigger and then, unless that trigger changed the stage, advances to the objective's nextStage under the same conditions as completion. A failed objective counts as finished for stage advancement and cannot be activated again.

parameters.description: The objective to fail.
parameters.name: objectiveID

HideObjective.description:
Marks an objective as hidden so that it is not presented to the player.

Hiding changes presentation only: a hidden objective still tracks progress and can still complete or fail. Nothing happens when it is already hidden. Hiding fires the objective's onHidden event trigger.

parameters.description: The objective to hide.
parameters.name: objectiveID

IssueOrders.description:
Gives the units with a name a list of orders, as if the player had issued them.

Every unit with the name receives the whole list. Each order is { command, params, options }: command is a command ID, or a unit def name for a build order; params are the command's numbers, such as { x, y, z } for a move or { x, y, z, radius } for an area command; and options are any of 'shift', 'alt', 'ctrl', 'right', and 'meta'. Add 'shift' to queue an order behind the previous ones; without it, the order replaces the unit's current queue. Where a command targets a unit or feature, params may be { unitName = '...' } or { featureName = '...' } instead, and the order is repeated for every unit or feature with that name, with the copies queued behind the first. UnitOrdered and RallyOrdered triggers ignore these orders unless they set ignoreMissionActions = false. Nothing happens when no unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units receive the orders.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: The orders to give, in list order.
parameters.name: orders

MoveUnits.description:
Teleports the units with a name to a position, optionally turning them to face a direction.

Every unit with the name is placed at the same position. The direction is either { angle = degrees }, a compass angle with 0 facing north and 90 facing east, or a point { x, z } that each unit turns to face; a unit placed exactly on that point keeps its facing. Nothing happens when no living unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units are moved.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: The destination in elmos. When y is omitted, the ground height at (x, z) is used.
parameters.name: position

parameters.description: The facing after the move. Units keep their facing when omitted.
parameters.name: direction

NameUnits.description:
Gives a name to existing units chosen by team, unit def, or area, so that later actions and triggers can refer to them.

The filters combine: a teamID alone names every unit the team owns, and a unitDefName or an area narrows the selection to units matching every filter given. Only units that exist when the action runs are named; units built later are not. A unit can hold several names, and naming it does not remove names it already has.

parameters.description: The name to give the selected units.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: Only units owned by this team.
parameters.name: teamID

parameters.description: Only units of this unit def.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: Only units inside this area: a rectangle { x1, z1, x2, z2 } or a circle { x, z, radius }, in elmos.
parameters.name: area

Pause.description: Pauses the game in a way players cannot undo; only Unpause ends it. The usual pause overlay is not shown.

PauseCountdown.description: Freezes the remaining time of a countdown until UnpauseCountdown resumes it. Does nothing when the countdown has ended or been canceled.

parameters.description: The countdown to pause.
parameters.name: countdownID

PlayMusic.description:
Plays a music track, interrupting the track that is playing.

The path is not checked when the mission loads.

parameters.description: The path of the music file within the game's files.
parameters.name: soundfile

PlaySound.description:
Plays a sound once, either right away or queued behind other queued sounds so that they do not overlap.

While a queued sound plays, the game's spoken notifications are held back for its length.

parameters.description: The path of a .wav file within the game's files; checked when the mission loads.
parameters.name: soundfile

parameters.description: The playback volume, where 1 is full volume.
parameters.name: volume

parameters.description: Plays the sound from this point in the world, with x and z in elmos and y defaulting to the ground height, instead of everywhere.
parameters.name: position

parameters.description: Whether to queue the sound after the queued sounds before it; false plays it immediately, over anything else.
parameters.name: enqueue

ReclaimUnits.description:
Removes the units with a name as if they were reclaimed, refunding their metal cost to a team.

Each unit's full metal cost is added to the receiving team's storage; no energy is refunded. The units leave no wreck and no explosion. UnitReclaimed triggers ignore this action unless they set ignoreMissionActions = false. Nothing happens when no living unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units are reclaimed.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: The team that receives the metal. When omitted, the team that owns the units receives it.
parameters.name: reclaimerTeam

RemoveAllLines.description: Erases every line drawn by DrawLines.

RemoveAllMapMarkers.description: Erases every marker placed by AddMapMarker.

RemoveBuildOption.description:
Takes a unit type out of the build options of a builder or factory type, for its current units and for every unit of that type built later, on every team. Queued orders to build it are dropped.

The option may be one the builder has by default or one added by AddBuildOption.

parameters.description: The unit type to remove as a build option.
parameters.name: builtDefName

parameters.description: The builder or factory type that loses the option.
parameters.name: builderDefName

RemoveLine.description: Erases a line drawn by DrawLines. Does nothing for a name that is not drawn.

parameters.description: The line to erase.
parameters.name: lineName

RemoveMapMarker.description: Erases the marker recorded under markerName. Does nothing for a name that is not recorded.

parameters.description: The marker to erase.
parameters.name: markerName

RemoveTime.description: Takes seconds off the remaining time of a countdown. The remaining time never goes below zero, and a countdown left at zero ends on its next tick. Does nothing when the countdown has ended or been canceled.

parameters.description: The countdown to shorten.
parameters.name: countdownID

parameters.description: The seconds to remove; the result is rounded to whole seconds.
parameters.name: seconds

RemoveUnitMarker.description:
Removes markers from every unit matching the filters.

A teamID on its own matches no units.

parameters.description: Only units carrying this mission unit name.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: Only units of this type.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: Only units of this team.
parameters.name: teamID

parameters.description: Remove only the marker of this type.
parameters.name: markerType

RotateUnits.description:
Turns the units with a name to face a direction.

The direction is either { angle = degrees }, a compass angle with 0 facing north and 90 facing east, or a point { x, z } that each unit turns to face; a unit standing exactly on that point keeps its facing. Nothing happens when no living unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units turn.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: The facing to apply.
parameters.name: direction

SelfDestructUnits.description:
Self-destructs the units with a name immediately, with their self-destruct explosion and wreck.

The units count as lost for the owning team, no team is credited with the kill, and UnitKilled triggers watching them fire. Nothing happens when no living unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units self-destruct.
parameters.name: unitName

SendMessage.description:
Adds a message to the battle log for the player to read.

The text is translated on the player's side, so messageKey is a translation key rather than display text. The entry is logged as a plain message, as opposed to a briefing, objective, notification, or dialogue entry.

parameters.description: The translation key of the message text.
parameters.name: messageKey

parameters.description: Values substituted into the translated text, keyed by placeholder name.
parameters.name: messageData

SetTime.description: Sets the remaining time of a countdown and restarts its ticking from now. Does nothing when the countdown has ended or been canceled.

parameters.description: The countdown to change.
parameters.name: countdownID

parameters.description: The new remaining time in seconds, rounded to whole seconds.
parameters.name: seconds

ShowObjective.description:
Clears an objective's hidden mark so that it is presented to the player again.

Nothing happens when the objective is not hidden. Showing fires the objective's onShown event trigger.

parameters.description: The objective to show.
parameters.name: objectiveID

SpawnExplosion.description:
Detonates a weapon's explosion at a position, as if that weapon had hit there.

The explosion uses the weapon's damage, area of effect, and crater settings, damages units, features, and the ground, and has no owner, so no team is credited with its kills.

parameters.description: The weapon whose explosion is spawned.
parameters.name: weaponDefName

parameters.description: Where the explosion happens, in elmos. When y is omitted, the ground height at (x, z) is used.
parameters.name: position

parameters.description: The direction the explosion travels, as a vector. Always give y, because an omitted y is filled with the ground height at (x, z) as for any position.
parameters.name: direction

SpawnUnits.description:
Creates units from a loadout, placing them on the map finished or under construction.

Each loadout entry gives unitDefName, x, z, and team, and may give y, facing (0 to 3, or n, e, s, w, or the full compass word; south when omitted), unitName, construction (true to spawn as an unfinished build), quantity with spacing (the units are arranged in a grid around x and z, with spacing elmos between footprints), neutral, and orders in the same form as IssueOrders. Entries with a unitName create that name, and every unit of the entry gets it. UnitOrdered and RallyOrdered triggers ignore the entry orders unless they set ignoreMissionActions = false.

parameters.description: The units to create, one entry per unit def and position.
parameters.name: unitLoadout

TransferUnits.description:
Gives the units with a name to another team.

The units keep their names. UnitCaptured and UnitReceived triggers ignore this action unless they set ignoreMissionActions = false; then captured decides which of the two fires. Nothing happens when no unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units change hands.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: The team that receives the units.
parameters.name: newTeam

parameters.description: Whether the transfer counts as a capture rather than a gift.
parameters.name: captured

UnitSelectable.description:
Allows or forbids the player to select the units with a name.

Unselectable units cannot be picked or given orders by the player, but they still obey orders from the mission. The setting applies to the units that have the name when the action runs; units named later are unaffected until the action runs again. Nothing happens when no unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units are affected.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: true lets the player select the units, and false prevents it.
parameters.name: selectable

UnitTargetable.description:
Allows or forbids enemies to target the units with a name.

Untargetable units are not fired on automatically and cannot be given a direct attack order, though ground and area attacks can still hit them. The setting applies to the units that have the name when the action runs; units named later are unaffected until the action runs again. Nothing happens when no unit has the name.

parameters.description: The name whose units are affected.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: true lets enemies target the units, and false protects them.
parameters.name: targetable

UnnameUnits.description:
Removes a name from every unit that has it.

The units stay in the game and keep any other names they hold. Afterwards, actions and triggers that refer to the name match nothing until units are named with it again.

parameters.description: The name to remove.
parameters.name: unitName

Unpause.description: Ends a pause started by Pause. A pause made by a player is left alone.

UnpauseCountdown.description: Resumes a countdown paused by PauseCountdown. Does nothing when the countdown has ended or been canceled.

parameters.description: The countdown to resume.
parameters.name: countdownID

UpdateObjective.description:
Advances an objective by one step of progress.

Only an active, unfinished objective advances. The objective completes when its progress reaches its amount, or immediately when it has no amount; otherwise its onProgress event trigger fires. Objectives whose trigger has a quantity track their own progress and are not meant to be advanced this way.

parameters.description: The objective to advance.
parameters.name: objectiveID

Victory.description: Ends the game with the listed ally teams as the winners.

parameters.description: The ally teams that win.
parameters.name: allyTeamIDs

DifficultiesWrapper.description: A value that depends on the difficulty. Any trigger parameter, action parameter, or objective field other than trigger may be written as { difficulties = { <difficultyName> = <value>, ... } } in place of a plain value. The wrapper replaces the whole value. It cannot be used for a field inside a compound value, such as one entry of a loadout or one field of an area, so the whole parameter is given per difficulty instead. The mission uses the value for the current difficulty, else the value for the nearest easier difficulty given, else the value for the easiest difficulty given.

fields.description: The value for each difficulty, keyed by difficulty name. At least one entry is required, and every name must be a known difficulty.
fields.name: difficulties

MissionAction.description: An action. It is run by the triggers that list its ID.

fields.description: The name of the action type.
fields.name: type

fields.description: The action's parameters, as described by its type. Each parameter may be given per difficulty with a DifficultiesWrapper.
fields.name: parameters

MissionFile.description: A mission. A mission file is a Lua file that returns one of these tables. Every part is optional, but a mission needs at least one trigger to do anything.

fields.description: The stage the mission starts in. Required when any stages are declared.
fields.name: InitialStage

fields.description: The stages of the mission, keyed by stage ID.
fields.name: Stages

fields.description: The objectives of the mission, keyed by objective ID.
fields.name: Objectives

fields.description: The triggers of the mission, keyed by trigger ID. IDs starting with two underscores are reserved.
fields.name: Triggers

fields.description: The actions of the mission, keyed by action ID. IDs starting with two underscores are reserved. Every action must be used by at least one trigger.
fields.name: Actions

fields.description: Units placed on the map before the game starts.
fields.name: UnitLoadout

fields.description: Features placed on the map before the game starts.
fields.name: FeatureLoadout

MissionObjective.description: An objective for the player. It completes when its trigger fires enough times, or when an action completes it. Each field except trigger may be given per difficulty with a DifficultiesWrapper.

fields.description: The translation key of the objective's text.
fields.name: textKey

fields.description: The condition that advances the objective. Without one, the objective only changes through actions.
fields.name: trigger

fields.description: How much the objective needs to complete. For a counting trigger, the count to reach, where zero means none left. For any other trigger, how many times it must fire. Without an amount, the objective completes the first time.
fields.name: amount

fields.description: The stage to move to once this objective is complete, and every other objective of the current stage with the same next stage is complete too.
fields.name: nextStage

fields.description: Reserved. It has no effect.
fields.name: coop

fields.description: Whether the objective starts hidden from the player.
fields.name: hidden

fields.description: An Event trigger that fires when the objective becomes active.
fields.name: onActivated

fields.description: An Event trigger that fires when the objective is canceled.
fields.name: onCanceled

fields.description: An Event trigger that fires when the objective advances without completing.
fields.name: onProgress

fields.description: An Event trigger that fires when the objective completes. It runs before the move to the next stage.
fields.name: onCompleted

fields.description: An Event trigger that fires when the objective fails. It runs before the move to the next stage.
fields.name: onFailed

fields.description: An Event trigger that fires when the objective is hidden.
fields.name: onHidden

fields.description: An Event trigger that fires when the objective is shown.
fields.name: onShown

MissionStage.description: A stage of the mission. Entering a stage activates the objectives it lists, and leaving it cancels those that did not finish. An objective listed by both the old and the new stage carries over untouched.

fields.description: The objectives that are active during this stage.
fields.name: objectives

MissionTrigger.description: A trigger. When its condition is met and its settings allow it, it runs its actions in order.

fields.description: The name of the trigger type.
fields.name: type

fields.description: The trigger's parameters, as described by its type. Each parameter may be given per difficulty with a DifficultiesWrapper.
fields.name: parameters

fields.description: When the trigger is allowed to fire.
fields.name: settings

fields.description: The IDs of the actions to run, in order. At least one is required.
fields.name: actions

ObjectiveTrigger.description: The condition that advances an objective. It is a trigger with a type and parameters only, so it has no settings and no actions of its own. A counting trigger, one with a quantity parameter, counts toward the objective's amount instead, so its quantity is ignored.

fields.description: The name of the trigger type.
fields.name: type

fields.description: The trigger's parameters, as described by its type.
fields.name: parameters

TriggerSettings.description: The settings that decide whether a trigger may fire. Every setting is optional.

fields.description: Triggers that must have fired before this one may fire.
fields.name: prerequisites

fields.description: Whether the trigger may fire more than once.
fields.name: repeating

fields.description: How many more times a repeating trigger may fire after its first time. Allowed only when repeating is true. Without it, a repeating trigger fires without limit.
fields.name: maxRepeats

fields.description: The difficulties on which the trigger may fire. Without it, or with an empty list, the trigger may fire on every difficulty.
fields.name: difficulties

fields.description: Reserved. It has no effect.
fields.name: coop

fields.description: Whether the trigger starts enabled. A disabled trigger may be enabled by an action.
fields.name: active

fields.description: The stages during which the trigger may fire. Without it, or with an empty list, the trigger may fire during any stage.
fields.name: stages

ConstructionCanceled.description:
Fires when a unit being built by a constructor is removed before it is finished, whether destroyed, canceled, or transferred to another team. Units in production at a factory are covered by ProductionCanceled instead.

A constructor that dies or drops its build order does not cancel the construction, since another constructor can still finish the unit.

parameters.description: Only the unit under construction with this name.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: Only units under construction of this unit definition.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: Only units under construction owned by this team.
parameters.name: teamID

ConstructionFinished.description: Fires when a unit that was under construction is completed. Units that enter the mission already complete do not count.

parameters.description: Only the completed unit with this name.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: Only completed units of this unit definition.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: Only completed units owned by this team.
parameters.name: teamID

ConstructionProgress.description: Fires when the build progress of a matching unit under construction reaches a fraction of completion. Each unit can fire the trigger only once, and units that are already complete when first checked do not count.

parameters.description: The build progress to reach, from 0 to 1.
parameters.name: progress

parameters.description: Only the unit under construction with this name.
parameters.name: unitName

parameters.description: Only units under construction of this unit definition.
parameters.name: unitDefName

parameters.description: Only units under construction owned by this team.
parameters.name: teamID

ConstructionStarted.description: Fires when a unit of the given definition starts being built, either as a new build frame or when the first builder matching the filters assists an existing one. Each unit under construction fires the trigger at most once, and units spawned by the mission while under construction count as started.

MissionStarted.description:
Fires once when the mission starts, after the starting units are placed and the first stage is active, and before any interactive gameplay.

Some effects of the mission setup may not have taken place yet when it fires.

ResourcePull.description: Fires when a team's demand for metal, energy, or both is at or above the given amounts per second. Demand is checked once per second, and both thresholds must be met when both are given. While repeating, it fires again every second the thresholds hold.

TotalUnitsBuilt.description:
Fires when the number of units a team has completed since the mission started reaches the quantity, and again at every further multiple of it while repeating. Units spawned by the mission and the team's starting units do not count.

As an objective's trigger, the running count is the objective's progress, the objective's amount is the target, and quantity is ignored.

parameters.name: teamID

parameters.description: Count at which to fire; while repeating, it fires again at every further multiple of this count.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.name: unitDefName

TotalUnitsCaptured.description:
Fires when the number of units a team has captured since the mission started reaches the quantity, and again at every further multiple of it while repeating.

As an objective's trigger, the running count is the objective's progress, the objective's amount is the target, and quantity is ignored.

Order.description:
One order for a unit, written as an array: the command, its parameters, and its options.
The command is a command ID from CMD or GameCMD, or the name of a unit definition to build.
The parameters depend on the command. Movement and attack commands take three numbers { x, y, z }. Area commands take four numbers { x, y, z, radius }. Build orders take { x, y, z } with an optional facing as a fourth number, or nothing for a factory. Commands that act on a unit or a feature may instead take { unitName = "name" } or { featureName = "name" }, which applies the order to every unit or feature with that name. State commands take a single number.
The options are an optional list of modifier names: "right", "alt", "ctrl", "shift", or "meta".

fields.description: The command: a command ID, or the name of a unit definition to build.
The command's parameters: an array of numbers, or a table naming a unit or a feature.
The order's modifier options, if any.
